summary: Iteration 10 - Template Preview Feature Testing Complete. All 13 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified working correctly. Preview dialog shows template name, description, fields grouped by step with numbered circles, mock field renderings with dashed borders, summary bar with field/required/custom counts, and 'Ativar este Template' button.

issues: Color contrast issue: White text on teal background (#0d9488) has contrast ratio of 3.74 (expected 4.5:1) - pre-existing issue from iteration 9

seed_data_creation: Test templates created during testing were cleaned up automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Template Preview feature fully tested and working. Backend API: GET /api/admin/form-config/templates/{id}/preview returns name, description, fields, is_system for both system and custom templates. Returns 404 for invalid template IDs. Frontend: FormManagementPage Templates dialog has 'Ver' button on each template card. Clicking 'Ver' opens preview dialog with: (1) Template name in title 'Pré-visualização: {name}', (2) Description text, (3) Summary bar showing 'X campos totais', 'Y obrigatórios', 'Z personalizados', and 'Sistema' badge for system templates, (4) Fields grouped by step with numbered circles and step labels (Dados Pessoais, Segundo Titular, etc.), (5) Mock field renderings with dashed borders - text fields show placeholder, number shows 0.00, date shows dd/mm/aaaa, select shows dropdown arrow, radio shows Sim/Não buttons, (6) Required field indicators '* obrigatório', (7) Field type badges (Texto, Dropdown, Data, Número, etc.), (8) 'Ativar este Template' button at bottom, (9) 'Fechar' button to close dialog.
